_comment: Widgets for the Directory tab. Copied to ~/.config/pidash/services.json by
the installer; edit it there and hit Refresh - no restart needed.
type: minecraft  Java-edition Server List Ping. Needs host + port.
Shows MOTD, players online/max, version, server icon.
type: jellyfin   Reads /System/Info/Public, which needs no API key.
type: http       Any URL. 'expect' is a status code, or "any" when the
service answers but needs auth (a 401 still means it is up).
type: tcp        Plain connect check. The fallback for anything else.
link: optional URL for the 'Open' button. Use a name your browser resolves,
not 127.0.0.1 - the link opens on your machine, not the Pi.
